versions.text: Criterion: Verify the other propulsion systems (e.g., rotary, wankel, electric) are safe. Standard: The propulsion system provides safe operation under all intended conditions. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, inspection and review of documentation. References: 14 CFR 33 subpart C for design requirements for commercial applications 14 CFR 33 subpart D for verification requirements for commercial applications
